common_name: Dhaka Cricket Frog (Bangladesh-endemic; described from Dhaka)
description_paper: Howlader, M.S.A., Nair, A., & Merilä, J. (2016). A New Species of Frog (Anura: Dicroglossidae) Discovered from the Mega City of Dhaka. PLOS ONE, 11(3), e0149597.
type_locality: Sher-e-Bangla Agricultural University campus, in front of Kabi Kazi Nazrul Islam Hall, Mirpur, Dhaka
habitat_requirements: Freshwater pond margins, vegetated canal edges, temporary rain pools in Dhaka urban zone
threat_narrative: Endemic to Bangladesh with its type locality in Dhaka. NOTE: secondary sources (Wikipedia and EOL, citing the original description) also report material from Mymensingh Division, so an exclusive Dhaka-district endemism claim must be verified against the paratype list in Howlader et al. (2016) before use [VERIFY]. Reported earth-filling and concretization of campus pond margins in Mirpur threatens its type locality habitat; zero GBIF records exist after the 2012 type series.
